runtime.execution: Asyncio turn/channel loop, Pluggy stage/interception callbacks, any-llm provider streams and native shell/fresh Python subprocess code actions.
runtime.service_boundary: Owns default append-style file tape, sidecars, scoped shell manager and session environment lifecycle; accepts caller-owned tape stores/environment plugins and consumes providers/channels.

summary: Operator/model tool symmetry, replaceable turn stages, tape-derived context, code-mode tool orchestration and channel admission/steering.

inspection.scope: framework/stage hooks, model/tool loop, tape projection/fork/merge/storage/query/overflow/spill, native shell/code/subagent and inspected mutation/lifecycle/archive test assertions
inspection.limits: No upstream execution. Provider SDK/channel/plugin implementations not fully inspected; default FileTapeStore/LocalEnvironment specifically traced and not generalized to all plugin-backed services.

actions.name: process_inbound / Agent.run_stream
actions.lifecycle: framework resolve→state→prompt→model→finally save→render→dispatch; SDK stream holds fork until consumed/closed
actions.authority: registered plugins and caller-owned explicit stores; same-session stream serialization caller concern

actions.name: resolve_session / load_state / build_prompt / run_model(_stream) / save_state / render_outbound / dispatch_outbound
actions.lifecycle: priority stage selection each call; save finally and lifespans close
actions.authority: operator/program entry-point plugin can replace whole turn; no live refit barrier implied

actions.name: before_llm_call / before_tool_call / after_tool_call
actions.lifecycle: ordered transformations; exceptions logged/skipped; cancellation not terminal after-LLM observation
actions.authority: plugin has substantial normal-turn agency; LLM tool_names observational

actions.name: bash / bash.output / bash.kill
actions.lifecycle: foreground timeout continues background; explicit kill; scoped shutdown drains pending spawn
actions.authority: selected Environment host groups/program authority; commands share tooling

actions.name: fs.read / fs.write / fs.edit; web.fetch
actions.lifecycle: await configured environment/file or HTTP request
actions.authority: default host path authority; caller controls plugins and tool filters

actions.name: run_code / code_mode
actions.surface: model Python action and operator setting command
actions.output: printed output or typed error with prior output; persisted next-turn setting
actions.lifecycle: fresh process each action, full builtins + tools RPC; pending RPC canceled/gathered on done, kill finally
actions.authority: enabled code tools/context; structured tool results bypass spill/post-render; not sandbox proof

actions.name: subagent
actions.lifecycle: await child stream; temp does not merge back; inherited named tape can share context
actions.authority: instance tool filters exclude recursive subagent; state shallow copied

actions.name: tape.info / tape.search / tape.anchors / tape.handoff / tape.reset
actions.output: entry matches/info/anchors/new boundary or archive/reset result
actions.lifecycle: handoff appends anchor/event, default context AFTER anchor; reset destructive unless archive
actions.authority: same native command/tool runtime; original tape distinct projected context

actions.name: spill.read / SpillStore.spill_tool_result
actions.output: preview/manifest/chunk pages/complete cursor or incomplete storage error
actions.lifecycle: UTF8 chunk archive, bounded retrieval; temporary fork discarded; failure returns truncated preview
actions.authority: mounted sibling tape authority, structured code values bypass spill

actions.name: admit_message / quit / steering inbox
actions.lifecycle: steer active else queue; quit clears pending and awaits canceled sibling tasks
actions.authority: channel plugin/operator policy, current caller excluded from self-cancel

actions.name: ,model / ,reasoning_effort / tool decorator
actions.output: next-turn persisted settings or registered named tool/schema
actions.lifecycle: tool registry snapshotted per Agent, plugins/later callbacks; no module hotreload contract
actions.authority: operators and model share callable primitives; model-use filters differ by tool

filesystem.detail: fs.read/write/edit delegate configured Environment; default native host paths allow absolute/expanded paths, no project-only sandbox inferred.

processes.detail: Native bash/group-spawn/output/kill and lifetime cleanup; timeout advertises still-running background handle, environment plugin can replace host.

code_actions.detail: Model run_code full Python/top-level await with structured async tools RPC, default fresh subprocess always killed afterward; code-mode chosen operator next-turn.

persistent_kernel.detail: Default code action fresh child namespace and teardown; shell handles resident manager, not kernel heap checkpoint/shared service. Environment plugin supports alternate composition.

standing_database.detail: Queryable tape/sidecar file records standing across turns; injectable caller-owned store protocol. Default file journal not general transactional shared DB.

workflow_programming.detail: All turn stages replaceable, code tools async orchestration, subagents with inheritance/temp/named session and model override; actual callable/discovery paths.

multi_model.detail: Per-turn/session model and subagent override with inherited/temp/named tapes; before-LLM model rewrite, provider candidates consume SDK.

live_collaboration.detail: Channel turn admission supports shared session process/steer/followup and subagent inherited/named sessions; SDK run_stream does not itself serialize concurrent same-session turns.

concurrent_work.detail: Tool gather, code RPC tasks, channel active tasks/subagents. Owned-work cleanup and temporary tape merge boundaries distinct from shared service lifecycle.

steering_interrupt.detail: Channel steer/followup and quit cancels/awaits siblings; code finally kills runner and gathers pending RPC, shell cleanup waits in-flight spawn. Hook terminal observations skip cancellation/consumer close.

turn_redefinition.detail: Stage plugins replace full flow; before-provider message/model transform/short circuit and tool argument/result transform are wired. Tool names observational in LLM request hook, not toolset mutation.

compaction.detail: Model manual handoff and overflow anchor move context boundary, originals remain tape; default after-anchor selection excludes stored anchor.state summary, overflow only records reason/error without substantive summary.

context_repair.detail: Queryable originals, anchor/selector plugin and tape.search can recover previous material; default malformed read/fork redaction/default anchor exclusion limit faithful automatic repair.

original_audit.detail: Append-style tape originals/spill-sidecar text retained when writes succeed; fork strips nontext inputs, posthooks may replace before record, cancellation skips after-LLM and completed-turn records, malformed rows ignored, reset destructive unless archive requested.

audit_query.detail: Native text/date/kind/limit/anchor query and tape tools; selected ForkTapeStore child path applies kind/anchor but omits text/date filters unlike parent store, so in-flight fork query semantics differ.

hot_change.detail: Model/reasoning/code-mode settings explicitly next-turn persisted tape events; dynamic plugin manager/stage selection supports composition but no safe executable source reload/refit activation barrier.

rebuild_continuity.detail: File tape/settings survive process restart and rebuild context; fresh code namespace/owned shell Maps and provider stream not restored. Exact shell cleanup test addresses shutdown race, not full compiled harness outpost.

remote_services.detail: Environment/store/provider/channel hooks consume alternate services; caller supplied store lifecycle belongs caller, default native environment owned by framework.

self_improvement.detail: Replaceable stage/code workflows and shared tools allow model/operator experiments; no inspected candidate harness evaluation/promotion or managed autoresearch program.

complaints.detail: on_error hooks, tape error/events/run correlation and plugin init diagnostics can underpin complaint filing; no dedicated external state-snapshot/bead-table contract.

authority.detail: Operator commands share native tool implementations, model allowed tool/skill filters, plugin explicit proceed/replace/deny; hook exceptions skipped rather than denied. Default full host Python/filesystem authority.

evaluation.detail: Exact hook argument propagation, shell cleanup race, monotonic entry IDs and spill archive tests validate mechanisms; social evaluation docs not treated as implemented truth/harness optimizer.

time_order.detail: Per-run correlation/date/IDs, tool results gather order and monotonic append IDs within tape object; sidecar/main fork merge nontransactional, effects happen before persisted record and cancellation can leave gaps.

evidence.claim: Loads builtins then entry-point plugins; failed init diagnostics; stage implementation precedence and caller-configurable manager.
Build fresh state from reversed hook contributions, then resolve/load/build/run/save/render/dispatch turn; save finally even model failure.
Turn stages replaceable, model changes next turn, environment supplied/cached per session and closed on runtime exit.
Build request then before-LLM transforms/finish; after once completed/failure but cancellation/consumer close bypasses; tools execute then record_chat.
ToolExecutor gathers independent invocations, preserves results order, failures structured; unexpected BaseException propagated.
Mutable effective argument pipeline reaches actual handler; after hooks may replace result, errors normalized. Sync callable not automatically offloaded.
LLM request chain change/model/messages/finish and tool argument chain/proceed/replace/deny; plugin exceptions skipped, not veto; after mutable result shared.
Context selection default LAST_ANCHOR builds after-last query; explicit selector/anchor=None can reconstruct all history.
read_messages filters context:false then projection; handoff appends anchor(state) and event without modifying old entries.
Default store query slices AFTER anchor, then date/query/kind/limit filters; anchor itself and its state summary are excluded from default messages.
Overflow auto-handoff writes reason/error state but no substantive summary, then retries original prompt once.
Fork parent read fallback silently empty on errors, child query filters kinds/anchor but not query/date; strips nontext prompt parts; merges sidecars then main nontransactionally.
File store incremental read skips malformed JSON/entries; append locks per cached tape object and assigns monotonic local IDs; no process lock/fsync contract in inspected writer.
Chat persists selected input/system/text/calls/results/usage event after tools; full provider response object not persisted raw.
Oversized rendered results chunked UTF8 in sidecar with manifest; failure returns bounded truncation notice/preview and diagnostic event rather than original.
Native bash returns background handle even foreground timeout, output/kill tools; environment read/write/edit delegated, direct operation no blanket routine prompt.
Local environment host filesystem/processes own Unix process groups, TERM/KILL; run_code delegates fresh child; paths resolve but no project-only sandbox.
Model run_code gets structured async tool RPC without text spill; timeout/error output; operator code_mode command recorded next-turn persistent setting.
Code runner spawns tool-call tasks per RPC; on done/failure cancels/gathers outstanding calls, cannot transactionally undo provider/external work.
Each code action new subprocess; always force stop/reap in finally, no persistent interpreter namespace.
Child compiles Python top-level await with full builtins and async tools namespace; no state transfer between actions.
Model tape info/search/reset/handoff/anchors/web.fetch/subagent; inherited/temp/named sessions, model override, filters prevent recursive subagent tool.
Admission process/drop/follow-up/steer; steer running turn else queue pending.
Quit clears pending and cancels/awaits active sibling tasks, avoids canceling current caller.
Operator model/reasoning settings recorded next-turn, persist across restarts; invalid model error next turn with recover command.
Exact native-handler result ran:safe-ls proves modified arguments execute, unlike decision-only transform.
Delayed spawn shutdown test asserts lifespan remains unsettled until spawn completes, closed-start rejection and processes terminated/Maps empty.

tests.focus: phase transform ordering and actual execution
tests.oracle: Hooks chain LIFO request/argument changes; exact ran:safe-ls proves modified args reached handler; deny asserts later hooks not called. Includes mutable after-result semantics. No full audit originals or refit oracle.

Actual source test gates delayed spawn, checks lifespan unresolved until spawn released, then closed-runtime rejection, child terminated and Maps empty. Read only; external daemons/provider settlement outside oracle.

tests.focus: oversized rendered result preservation/archive and code mode boundary
tests.oracle: Archive checks main/spill handle/file presence then reset no-result; code-mode exact structured large value remains unchanged/unspilled. Handle containment alone is weaker than complete archive byte recovery, other page tests compare original text.

tests.focus: append identity on repeated fork merge
tests.oracle: Exact IDs [1,2] and names prove monotonic parent IDs across sequential merges, not multi-process writer/crash transaction correctness.

strengths: Full turn-stage replacement plus actual effective tool input/result transforms, with operator/model native callable symmetry.
Queryable original tape distinct from model projection; large text retained as UTF8 chunks when spill succeeds.
Next-turn settings and scoped native process cleanup have explicit activation/lifetime semantics and useful race oracle.
limits: Default after-anchor context excludes anchor-state summary; overflow handoff lacks substantive summary.
Fork strips nontext inputs; posthooks/temporary fork/spill failure/cancellation and malformed rows bound original audit.
File append/fork merge no complete cross-process transaction; fresh code action and resident shell Maps not rebuild shared-kernel continuity.
arconaut_questions: Can tape-like exact original custody and configurable projections preserve media, pre/post transformations and canceled/late events without default data loss?
What contract makes handoff summary actually visible after its boundary and allows model-governed repair?
Can stage/environment plugins act as consumers of shared services while owned work inventory enforces refit quiescence?
